rows.normalized: Contractor must support the cable reel on a stand.

rows.verbatim: Place cable in the trench by hand.
rows.normalized: Contractor must place cable in the trench by hand.

rows.normalized: Contractor must inspect cable as it is removed from the reel during laying to ensure it is free from visible defects.

rows.normalized: Contractor must install metallic core marking tape above each electrical conduit as shown on drawings.

rows.verbatim: After backfilling perform high - pot tests described below.

rows.verbatim: Maintain for a minimum of five minutes a DC test potential voltage as follows:

rows.verbatim: All faults discovered by this test shall be corrected and the tests rerun until cable splice meet requirements.

rows.verbatim: Limit fine grading to areas that can be planted in the immediate future.
rows.normalized: Contractor must limit fine grading to areas plantable in the immediate future.

rows.verbatim: Restore areas if eroded or otherwise disturbed after finish grading and before planting.
rows.normalized: If areas are eroded or disturbed after finish grading and before planting, contractor must restore them.

rows.verbatim: Scarify existing subsoil and compacted areas prior to spreading topsoil.
rows.normalized: Contractor must scarify existing subsoil and compacted areas prior to spreading topsoil.

rows.verbatim: Prepare subsoil to eliminate uneven areas.
rows.normalized: Contractor must prepare subsoil to eliminate uneven areas.

rows.verbatim: Maintain profiles and contours.
rows.normalized: Contractor must maintain profiles and contours.

rows.verbatim: Make changes in grade gradual.
rows.normalized: Contractor must make changes in grade gradual.

rows.verbatim: Blend slopes into level areas.
rows.normalized: Contractor must blend slopes into level areas.

rows.verbatim: Rake the surface smooth.
rows.normalized: Contractor must rake the surface smooth.

rows.verbatim: Place topsoil during dry weather and on dry, unfrozen subgrade.
rows.normalized: Contractor must place topsoil during dry weather and on dry, unfrozen subgrade.

rows.verbatim: Remove foreign, non-organic material from topsoil while spreading.
rows.normalized: Contractor must remove foreign, non-organic material from topsoil while spreading.

rows.verbatim: Grade topsoil to eliminate rough, low or soft areas and to ensure positive drainage.
rows.normalized: Contractor must grade topsoil to eliminate rough, low, or soft areas and ensure positive drainage.

rows.verbatim: All seeded areas to receive a settled minimum depth of 4” of topsoil.
rows.normalized: Contractor must ensure all seeded areas receive a settled minimum depth of 4 inches of topsoil.

rows.verbatim: Remove foreign materials, weeds and undesirable pants and their roots.
rows.normalized: Contractor must remove foreign materials, weeds, and undesirable plants and their roots.

rows.verbatim: Remove any contaminated subsoil if present.
rows.normalized: If contaminated subsoil is present, contractor must remove it.

rows.verbatim: Prepare seeding areas by removing and/or killing off any unwanted existing vegetation with a glyphosate herbicide, applied only by a state certified applicator no sooner than 2 weeks prior to seed installation.
rows.normalized: Contractor must prepare seeding areas by removing/killing unwanted vegetation using glyphosate herbicide applied only by a state certified applicator no sooner than 2 weeks before seed installation.

rows.verbatim: Soils surface should be loose and free of any soil clumps exceeding 1 inch in diameter.
rows.normalized: Soil surface should be loose and free of clumps exceeding 1 inch in diameter.

rows.verbatim: Seed shall be installed by means of mechanical and/or hand broadcast methods to ensure even distribution of seeds throughout all designated seeded areas.
rows.normalized: Contractor shall install seed by mechanical and/or hand broadcast methods to ensure even distribution.

rows.verbatim: Native seed mix shall be mixed thoroughly by vendor/supplier at their recommended ratios.
rows.normalized: Vendor/supplier shall thoroughly mix native seed mix at recommended ratios, which contractor must ensure.

rows.verbatim: Apply seed evenly in two intersecting directions.
rows.normalized: Contractor must apply seed evenly in two intersecting directions.

rows.verbatim: Rake in lightly, then lightly mulch with clean, weed free straw.
rows.normalized: Contractor must rake in seed lightly, then lightly mulch with clean, weed-free straw.

rows.verbatim: Seeded areas shall be watered immediately following installation to accelerate cover crop germination.
rows.normalized: Contractor shall water seeded areas immediately following installation.

rows.verbatim: No bare spots larger than 1 square foot after substantial germination.
rows.normalized: Acceptable seed installation requires no bare spots larger than 1 square foot after substantial germination.

rows.verbatim: No more than 10% of the total area with bare spots larger than 1 square foot.
rows.normalized: Acceptable seed installation requires no more than 10% of total area with bare spots larger than 1 square foot.

rows.verbatim: A uniform coverage throughout all seeded areas.
rows.normalized: Acceptable seed installation requires uniform coverage throughout all seeded areas.

rows.verbatim: Do not perform seeding in windy conditions.
rows.normalized: Contractor must not perform seeding in windy conditions.

rows.verbatim: Surface layer of soil for seeded areas shall be kept moist throughout gemination period.
rows.normalized: Contractor shall keep the surface layer of soil for seeded areas moist throughout the germination period.

rows.verbatim: Mulch the areas with a light covering of clean, chopped straw to retain moisture and use a tackifier to prevent wind damage.
rows.normalized: Contractor must mulch areas with a light covering of clean, chopped straw and use a tackifier to prevent wind damage.

rows.verbatim: If installed in spring, lightly water 4-6 weeks after germination at regular intervals (depending on rainfall), or if an extended drought occurs throughout the summer months.
rows.normalized: If installed in spring, contractor must lightly water 4-6 weeks after germination at regular intervals or during extended drought.

rows.verbatim: Protect seeded areas from pedestrian traffic or vehicular trespassing with temporary fences, signs, barriers, etc. while seed is germinating.
rows.normalized: Contractor must protect seeded areas from pedestrian and vehicular trespass with temporary fences, signs, or barriers while seed germinates.

rows.verbatim: Repair damage resulting from trespass, erosion, settlement, etc.
rows.normalized: Contractor must repair damage resulting from trespass, erosion, settlement, etc.

rows.verbatim: Remove temporary protective devices after final acceptance.
rows.normalized: Contractor must remove temporary protective devices after final acceptance.

rows.verbatim: Maintain seeded areas immediately after placement until vegetation is well established and exhibits a vigorous growing condition.
rows.normalized: Contractor must maintain seeded areas until vegetation is well established and vigorous.

rows.verbatim: Control the growth of weeds to the extent possible by using various methods such as line trimming, mowing and selective herbicide use.
rows.normalized: Contractor must control weed growth using methods such as line trimming, mowing, and selective herbicide use.

rows.verbatim: Apply herbicide in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.
rows.normalized: Contractor must apply herbicide in accordance with manufacturer's instructions.

rows.verbatim: Contractor will be responsible for any damage resulting from improper use of herbicides.
rows.normalized: Contractor will be responsible for any damage resulting from improper herbicide use.

rows.verbatim: Immediately reseed areas that show bare spots.
rows.normalized: Contractor must immediately reseed areas showing bare spots.

rows.verbatim: An acceptable quality seed installation is defined as having: 1. No bare spots larger than 1 square foot after substantial germination. 2. No more than 10% of the total area with bare spots larger than 1 square foot. 3. A uniform coverage throughout all seeded areas.
rows.normalized: Seed installation must meet defined acceptance criteria for bare spots and uniform coverage to be acceptable.

Well shall be pump tested to determine its maximum pumping rate at a stabilized drawdown which does not
exceed 1.5 times the design pumping rate (15 gpm) or the maximum amount the screen (if present) can
safely pass.
rows.normalized: Contractor shall pump test the well to determine maximum pumping rate at a stabilized drawdown not exceeding 1.5 times the design pumping rate (15 gpm) or the maximum the screen can safely pass.
